entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-09-16
entry.summary: Superintendent's draft FY27 evaluation goals: ELA growth, professional culture, Turkey Hill MSBA SOI, and financial leadership

entry.title: The turf field and track study: School Committee, 2026-09-16
entry.summary: Request the town raise/appropriate/borrow funds for a full feasibility and schematic study of the turf field, track, drainage and retaining wall, as a placeholder warrant article — passed 5-0 (all yes on roll call)

entry.title: The turf field and track study: Conservation Commission, 2026-09-16
entry.summary: NOI: concrete boat ramp reconstruction and retaining wall at Shady Point, Lake Shirley

entry.title: The paraprofessional contract: School Committee, 2026-09-16
entry.summary: Pass over the reratification of the paraprofessional contract — passed (roll call, all yes)

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-09-15
entry.summary: The board will not pursue a MassWorks grant to study senior housing at the former TCP school this grant cycle, saying more public discussion is needed first.

entry.title: The stormwater fee: Select Board, 2026-09-15
entry.summary: Refer the special town meeting articles (zoning amendments and stormwater management bylaw fee structure) to the planning board for review and public hearing. — passed unanimously

entry.title: Brooks House: what becomes of it: Select Board, 2026-09-15
entry.summary: The Brooks House long-term sale/lease report will be presented by subject-matter experts (planning, economic development and facilities staff) at the November special town meeting, closing out the November 2024 non-binding vote directive.

entry.title: 925 Mass Ave: the RFP: Select Board, 2026-09-15
entry.summary: Town manager report: 925 Mass Ave RFP, FY26 close-out, municipal aggregation, law training, recruitments and vacancies

entry.title: The stormwater fee: Stormwater Task Force, 2026-09-14
entry.summary: Vote to accept the stormwater warrant article for special town meeting

entry.title: Trust fund administration during a vacancy: Trust Fund Commission, 2026-09-10
entry.summary: Approve the rewritten warrant article on continuity of trust fund administration during a vacancy on the board, as amended per the lawyer's comments, for submission to the select board/town meeting warrant — passed unanimously (2-0), roll call: John Bowen aye, Richard Howard aye

entry.title: The veterans property tax exemption: Board of Assessors, 2026-09-09
entry.summary: A placeholder will be requested for a veterans' exemption increase warrant article for the November 17th special town meeting, with research to be discussed at the September 23rd meeting.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-09-09
entry.summary: Formal review/vote on school committee goals for the year is deferred to next week; goals discussed include continuing the Turkey Hill MSBA process, implementing the primary school parking lot/playground study, and pursuing financial stability including using audit findings.

entry.title: The sewer pump station contract: Sewer Commission, 2026-09-08
entry.summary: Authorize development and advertising of a comprehensive procurement combining sewer pump station operations, maintenance, emergency services, and construction/capital repair work into a single multi-year contract, and recommend a warrant article authorizing the town to enter such a contract at the November 17, 2026 special town meeting. — passed (heard as "motion carries")

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Town Meeting, 2026-09-03
entry.summary: Transfer from the Winter Recovery Assistance Program (WRAP) special revenue fund to supplement the FY27 Lunenburg public schools operating budget, for restored middle school sports and transportation (Article 3, Motion A) — passed

entry.title: The stormwater fee: Select Board, 2026-09-01
entry.summary: Committee reports: finance committee and stormwater task force update

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-09-01
entry.summary: establish a special revenue fund seeded with $36,000 of RAP (Winter Recovery Assistance Program) money, to serve as the funding source for Article 3 (middle school sports restoration) — passed, unanimous

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-08-31
entry.summary: Committee agreed to ask the feasibility study to scope three options for the TC Pasios site: senior housing alone, senior housing plus a community center, and senior housing plus community center plus a town green.

entry.title: The stormwater fee: Stormwater Task Force, 2026-08-31
entry.summary: Agreed stormwater fees will be billed separately from the property tax bill, with an option for residents to pay quarterly via a tear-off coupon.

entry.title: The Salary Administration Plan rewrite: Personnel Committee, 2026-08-31
entry.summary: Committee will consider a future SAP bylaw amendment exempting job descriptions reviewed and approved within a set prior period (e.g. two years) from re-review before posting, if there is no proposed change.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Finance Committee, 2026-08-27
entry.summary: Public and board discussion of specific sports funding figures for article 3 (ski team, girls lacrosse, middle school sports)

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: School Committee, 2026-08-26
entry.summary: The school committee will support the spirit of whatever the citizens' petition (warrant article 3) proposes, if funded from a new town source outside the schools' own budget, and will spend it as requested if appropriated at the special town meeting. — passed

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: Old business: Lunenburg municipal buildings (Brooks House, TCP, Ritter tour discussion)

entry.title: The stormwater fee: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: Committee reports (Council on Aging, Municipal Building Design Committee, Cable Advisory, Board of Assessors, Stormwater Task Force, Finance Committee)

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: No vote will be taken on the WRAP funds tonight; the board will wait to hear from the School Committee (Wednesday) and Finance Committee public hearing (Aug 27) before deciding, likely at the September 1 meeting.

entry.title: Brooks House: what becomes of it: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: Old business: Lunenburg municipal buildings (Brooks House, TCP, Ritter tour discussion)

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Finance Committee, 2026-08-13
entry.summary: Chair asked the school committee to meet (tentatively August 26) before the August 27 public hearing to take up and discuss the citizens petition article.

entry.summary: Opening statement and roll call at Brooks House

entry.title: Brooks House: what becomes of it: Select Board, 2026-08-10

entry.summary: Facilities director Chris Ruth will continue developing separated cost estimates for TCP (needs vs. wants, roof, ADA triggers, systems) before the board decides on outside consultants.

entry.title: Brooks House: what becomes of it: Select Board, 2026-08-04
entry.summary: A tour of TC Pacios and Brooks House with the Municipal Building Design Committee was scheduled for Tuesday, August 11th at 4:00 p.m., to be posted as a public meeting.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-07-29
entry.summary: Committee agreed it needs an MSBA primer/presentation for a future meeting and to begin familiarizing itself and the public with the MSBA process for Turkey Hill.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: School Committee, 2026-07-29
entry.summary: Committee decided to submit its own school-committee warrant article for the additional state aid, rather than relying solely on Mandy Gilman's citizen petition, so the request could go through school committee process and be adjustable.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Select Board, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: MSBA accelerated repair program timeline and its bearing on TCP/Turkey Hill decisions

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: No formal vote taken, but the majority sentiment expressed around the table was against putting more money into TCP (leaning toward demolition rather than roof repair), pending a formal committee vote at a future meeting.

entry.title: Brooks House: what becomes of it: Select Board, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: Select Board asked the Building Design Committee to bring back a formal recommendation/vote on the disposition of Brooks House.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-07-27
entry.summary: Call a special town meeting for Thursday, September 3, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at the Lunenburg Middle High School Auditorium, per the citizens' petition, and open the warrant July 28, 2026 with it closing 5:00 p.m. Friday, August 7, 2026. — passed unanimously
